analysis_type: Post-hoc offline input-decision replay only; no target inference and no new HTTP end-to-end results
data_scope: All 40 predeclared documents; actual detection-policy paragraph/segment layer results, with no omitted samples
aggregation: Reconstruct paired L1,L2,L3 results for each original overlapping input segment. Call unchanged fuse_results once per segment, then any segment per paragraph and any paragraph per document. Never fuse max scores across different segments.
